record.name: Papua New Guinea
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. A draft national AI strategy under consultation proposes a digital economy regulator that would also cover AI safety.

related_bodies.name: National Digital Economy Authority (proposed)
related_bodies.role: Its proposed tasks include AI safety standards, risk classification and certification. The draft strategy proposes it as a regulator.

searches.query: Papua New Guinea AI safety institute national strategy

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: PG-search = searches 1, 2 (en, en). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: DICT states that AI principles should sit within existing digital laws and governance frameworks, rather than a standalone AI law.

record.notes: In September 2026, DICT described a preference for incorporating AI principles into existing digital legislation. The regulator discussed in an earlier draft was not established by that announcement. English-language searches for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models included a separate search of ict.gov.pg.
